title: Gender equality

blocks.heading: Gender equality
blocks.text: Gender equality means equal rights, opportunities and treatment regardless of gender; formal equality does not by itself establish equal lived outcomes. Equal admission rules can coexist with barriers such as cost, safety, caring responsibilities or discrimination. Judge actual access as well as the written rule.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: A practical access test
blocks.text: A fictional skills centre allows all qualified applicants to enrol but provides instructions only in a language some applicants cannot use. Equal eligibility is a formal opportunity; understandable information is part of practical access. Suitable communication and feedback may widen participation. Check whether the relevant groups actually enrol and complete the programme rather than assuming that a rule change produces equal outcomes.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
